# Molecular views

Assign colors by recorded molecule identity, independently of chain letters.
Record target/binder/domain colors per campaign; separate cartoon and atom colors.
Use HIS purple, ASP/GLU blue, ARG/LYS red, actual NAG yellow, original target
hotspots green and editable interface hotspots tv_orange. Record overlap priority.
Keep standard non-carbon element colors. Never invent glycans or missing residues.

Comparable panels share saved cameras. Record alignments, references, coordinate
transformations, numbering maps and omitted display components. Keep native
coordinates for scoring. Preserve PML/view settings, input hashes and render
versions; inspect exported images and presentations.
